items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 120:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Righteous who is lost? In the days of the Temple, Aba and Ima were permanently in the stature of AB, and the ZON were in the degree of Aba and Ima, and the souls born of the ZON were in the aspect of face to face. However, after the destruction of the Temple, this great coupling disappeared from the aspect of permanence, and there is in permanence only the coupling for the life of the worlds, but the upper coupling ceased, and is not permanent. And upon that Yesod of greatness that disappeared from the aspect of permanence, it is said: "the Righteous is lost, etc." (Item 56).
